sloka: ततः पूर्वेण तौ गत्वा त्रि क्रोसम् भ्रातरु तदा ।क्रौंचारण्यम् अतिक्रम्य मातंग आश्रम अंतरा ॥३-६९-८॥
transliteration: tataḥ pūrveṇa tau gatvā tri krosam bhrātaru tadā ।krauṁcāraṇyam atikramya mātaṁga āśrama aṁtarā ॥3-69-8॥

translations.english: Then both the sons of Dasaratha, went further east, crossed the kraunchaforest after three krosas. They saw a dreadful forest which was full of fierce animals and birds near the hermitage of sage Matanga. It was densely covered with trees. They saw there a cave perpetually enveloped in darkness which was as deep as the netherworld.
translations.hindi: तब देश और काल के जानने वाले श्रीरामचन्द्र ओर लक्ष्मण अपनी अपनी तलवारों से उसकी बाह्र सहज में कन्धे से काट डाली
